tasks.label: build
args: if (!(Test-Path 'output\menu')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'output\menu' -Force | Out-Null }; gcc -Wall -Wextra -g3 -I. -Iobject -Imenu -Iutils -finput-charset=UTF-8 -fexec-charset=GBK menu/Sign.c menu/MainMenuAdmin.c menu/MainMenuGuest.c utils/SignUtil.c object/User.c utils/ExceptionUtil.c object/WaterQualityRecords.c utils/TxtFileUtil.c -lm -o output\menu\Sign.exe
